brief: A self-hosted home for one creator's YouTube, TikTok, Instagram and LinkedIn numbers. The old mark was a generic bars tile. The new one must read as the name, sit in a slim navy and violet interface, and hold at 16 px.
criteria: Success: ownable against bar-chart marks, readable at 16 px, works in one colour and on navy.

concepts.name: One line
concepts.idea: One stroke writes the C, then spikes up into the A.
rationale: The spike is the shape of a creator's numbers: flat, then a sharp jump
Built from one arc and two lines at 60 and 75 degrees
A dedicated small cut keeps the C open at 16 px

recommendation: One line, in violet on light and white on navy or violet.
